section_summary.extract_value: This section details the dependent variables: Depression, measured by the 5-item Geriatric Depression Scale (GDS), and Loneliness, assessed by the 3-item loneliness scale. It discusses the validity and reliability of both scales, citing previous research and pilot testing results. The pilot testing, conducted with a sample of 63 older adults from Ado-Ekiti, showed positive correlations between the 5-item GDS and the Geriatric Anxiety Inventory-Short Form (r = .43), and between the 3-item loneliness scale and both the Geriatric Anxiety Inventory-Short Form (r = .41) and the 5-item GDS (r = .32).
